scope.supports: A complete finite native basis census on the fixed 18-ray input, exact real-symmetric rational tomography, strict/semidefinite shifted-matrix bounds and explicit negative quadratic witnesses. Kernel checks are on the actual listed integer certificates.
scope.does_not_support: A formal Lean theorem identifying the entire real polytope vertex set, a general real spectral/PSD transport theorem, or positivity from finite frame additivity.
scope.narrowest_claim: Independently exhaustive exact basis computations and every actual finite matrix witness, with a separate literal integer-list kernel certificate; the general real-polytope completeness bridge remains open.
scope.next_test: Review basis coverage, source geometry, generated-data translation and the exact strict/non-strict spectral tests before promoting any broader claim.
